answer: Escrow plus a public referral graph stops bulk fakes: a newcomer locks a 50-unit timber deposit backed by a vetted agent. Honest work over 20 epochs returns the deposit; a proven dispute burns it, fines the backer, and removes the identity. A narrow canyon from one backer is flagged, and honest referrals build a reef no attacker can fake. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 100,000 units for 30,000; one honest agent pays 50 once, keeps its full share.
